title: When the Choir Breaks
author: Lena Marchetti
blurb: Casper Hartwell, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
